strategy.thesis: Cross-border (Japan/US) early-stage VC focused on B2B software. Thesis centers on Japan's labor shortage and digitization driving demand for cloud SaaS that transforms legacy enterprise markets.

summary.en: Cross-border Japan/US early-stage VC founded in 2011, focused on B2B software (cloud SaaS, fintech, deep tech, climate). Closed Japan Fund IV at $188M and Japan Annex Fund III at $55M in 2024; ~$750M total AUM across eight funds, 190+ investments and 23 exits. Operates the SPROUND seed incubation community in Tokyo.

strategy.thesis: Independent 'ecosystem VC' supporting Japanese founders from seed to Series C with capital, talent and insights. Invests across a wide range from SaaS to deep tech; heavily weighted toward B2B SaaS/enterprise (flagship: SmartHR).

summary.en: Leading Tokyo-based independent VC, founded in 2019 by the former 500 Startups Japan team (James Riney, Yohei Sawayama). Invests seed to Series C across SaaS to deep tech with checks of ¥30M–¥3B; Coral Capital IV is JPY 25 billion with total AUM ~JPY 60 billion. Backed 100+ companies including unicorn SmartHR.

strategy.thesis: Corporate VC arm of Salesforce investing in B2B SaaS / enterprise cloud startups, with emphasis on companies that integrate with or extend the Salesforce platform and the 'future of work'.

summary.en: Japan arm of Salesforce's corporate venture program. Launched the $100M Japan Trailblazer Fund in 2018 to back B2B SaaS / enterprise cloud startups, especially those integrating with the Salesforce platform. Japan portfolio includes freee, Sansan, BizReach and TeamSpirit.
